field.rollup_note: depth/column figures are sums of census_density over that row or column; patches use the same four-neighbour adjacency as movement. The full grid for this shift is in state/field_log.jsonl.

note: Both coordinates are real. Depth is position on the light gradient; lateral is a genuine place in the field that specimens move along and that carries no light. Only the scatter within a cell is cosmetic, so two specimens in one cell can be told apart.
